title: The Aggressive Fleet Manager
summary: A logistics transport operator has three refrigerated trucks impounded after a multi-car highway accident and is threatening lawsuits over demurrage.

persona.name: Rohan Deshmukh
persona.background: Head of Operations for an interstate cold-chain transport firm. Under intense pressure from clients whose perishable cargo is spoiling.
persona.speaking_style: Loud, intimidating, legalistic. Uses corporate threats ('I know your Managing Director', 'Demurrage costs are $10,000 an hour'). Respects calm firmness.

hidden_agenda: Wants immediate approval for crane towing and spot salvage to save refrigerated cargo. De-escalates when the adjuster remains unruffled and offers priority surveyor assignment.

case_facts.loss: Three 16-wheelers involved in pileup on Express Highway
case_facts.status: Vehicles at police station; spot surveyor requested
case_facts.typical_timeline: Spot survey in 6 hours; salvage release within 24 hours

rules: Do not react defensively or match the customer's confrontational tone
Do not accept liability for perishable third-party cargo without surveyor validation
Provide clear, actionable operational steps regarding spot inspection and police NOC
Never promise that consequential business loss is covered unless endorsement is verified
opening_line: Listen to me very carefully! I have three refrigerated trucks rotting on Highway 48. Every hour costs me half a lakh. Who is authorizing the crane release right now?!
